### Contributing guidelines

- [X] I have read [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](https://github.com/echasnovski/mini.nvim/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)

### Module(s)

mini.pairs

### Question

Hi, I’m trying to configure my neovim and mini.nvim has helped me a lot. However, I’m having an issue with mini.pairs. How can I add a newline with indentation between brackets when pressing Enter?

By default, it behaves like this:

```
{
|}
```

But I want it to work like this when I press Enter:

```
{
   |
}
```

Question

Hi, I’m trying to configure my neovim and mini.nvim has helped me a lot. However, I’m having an issue with mini.pairs. How can I add a newline with indentation between brackets when pressing Enter?

By default, it behaves like this:

{
|}

But I want it to work like this when I press Enter:

{
   |
}

comment_data.body:
Pressing `<CR>` [does behave like that](https://github.com/echasnovski/mini.nvim/blob/1f782e38109e3380fc339b794183019ac957fd21/doc/mini-pairs.txt#L16) with only 'mini.pairs' enabled. You can also see that at the end of [the demo](https://github.com/echasnovski/mini.nvim/blob/main/readmes/mini-pairs.md#demo).

Chances are that something else overrides `<CR>` in Insert mode (maybe completion plugin?). What does executing `:imap <CR>` show? It should show something like `v:lua.MiniPairs.cr()` and `MiniPairs <CR>`.

For all (registered) pairs to act like that after pressing `<CR>`, the [`MiniPairs.cr`](https://github.com/echasnovski/mini.nvim/blob/1f782e38109e3380fc339b794183019ac957fd21/doc/mini-pairs.txt#L320) function needs to be used inside expression mapping. Here is [an example from my config](https://github.com/echasnovski/nvim/blob/4c92d18eab0b1b12d15daf8fa16b53e6b61852c9/plugin/20_mini.lua#L285) with [custom `cr_action` function](https://github.com/echasnovski/nvim/blob/4c92d18eab0b1b12d15daf8fa16b53e6b61852c9/plugin/12_functions.lua#L65-L72).
